request.initial_prompt: Fool. Thou wast a pretty fellow when thou hadst no need to care for her frowning. Now thou art an O without a figure: I am better than thou art now. I am a fool, thou art nothing. [_To Goneril._] Yes, forsooth, I will hold my tongue. So your face bids me, though you say nothing. Mum, mum, He that keeps nor crust nor crum, Weary of all, shall want some.

raw_segments.text: Fool, thou wast a pretty fellow when thou hadst no need to care for her frowning. Now thou art an O without a figure, I am better than thou art now. I am a fool, thou art nothing. To Goneril. Yes, forsooth, I will hold my tongue. So your face bids me, though you say nothing. Mum, mum, He that keeps nor crust nor crum Weary of all, shall want some.
As a fool, thou hast no need to care for her frowning. Now thou art an O without a figure, I am a fool, shall want some.
